changelog: Sales: a lead marked lost while its trial still runs is pointed out — a "Still in trial · N days left" chip on its board card (the team view's cards too; `GET /api/sales/team-book` rows now carry `trialEndsAt`) and a notice at the top of the lead page with "Back to trial", an ordinary stage move through `PUT /api/mentorship/[id]` that keeps the trial window. One predicate, `lostWhileTrialOpen()` in `src/lib/trialReminderRule.ts` (unit-tested); nothing moves on its own, and a colleague's read-only view gets the notice without the button (#3813).

en: A lead marked lost while its trial is still running is now pointed out: a "Still in trial" chip on the board and a notice on the lead page, with "Back to trial" one click away.
tr: Kaybedildi işaretlendiği hâlde deneme süresi devam eden lead'ler artık görünüyor: panoda "Deneme sürüyor" rozeti, lead sayfasında bir uyarı ve tek tıkla "Denemeye geri al".
de: Ein als verloren markierter Lead, dessen Testphase noch läuft, wird jetzt angezeigt: ein Hinweis „Testphase läuft noch“ auf dem Board und auf der Lead-Seite, mit „Zurück in die Testphase“ per Klick.
